slides.texte_overlay:
How to completely restart
your life from the inside
Clean out your life like a messy room. Old clothes, old papers, old habits, old grudges. Making space is the first step to becoming someone new.
Pick one keystone habit. Training, early nights or reading. One good habit pulls many others with it without much extra effort. Start with the easiest one.
Spend a day alone with a notebook. Write what you want in five years and what's in the way. Clarity is the fuel of every real restart.
Change your surroundings. Rearrange your room, find a new café, take a new route. A new setting makes new behaviour feel natural. Even a small change counts.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Fresh ideas every morning help you see your life with new eyes.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Fresh ideas every morning help you see your life with new eyes.

slides.texte_overlay: Say yes to new things for a month. A class, a trip, an invitation. Every new experience shows you a version of yourself you didn't know.
Measure progress weekly, not daily. Some days feel like nothing changed. A week at a time shows you how far you've really come. Keep a short weekly note.
